title: Public Domain 12M: A Highly Aesthetic Image-Text Dataset with Novel Governance Mechanisms

bias_targets.methodology: Filtering dataset instances by cross-referencing metadata and conducting semantic searches against a Wikipedia list of known ethnophaulisms (ethnic slurs) to identify and remove derogatory images and text.

Qualitative assessment of the dataset's composition, noting that relying on digitized public domain content and GLAM (galleries, libraries, archives, and museums) sources inherently over-represents Western geographic regions and cultures.

Qualitative assessment of the dataset's time distribution, observing that strict public domain and CC0 licensing constraints result in an over-representation of older content, which limits applicability to contemporary visual tasks.
